# Glossary

| Term | Definition | Chapter |
| --- | --- | --- |
| abstract syntax tree | a tree structure that represents source code | [Macros: code that builds code](../chapters/macros.qmd) |
| address | the location of a value in memory, obtained with `addr` | [`ref`, `ptr`, and `nil`](../chapters/refs-and-pointers.qmd) |
| anonymous procedure | a nameless procedure used as a value | [Closures and captured variables](../chapters/closures.qmd) |
| application binary interface | the rules for layout and calls at the binary level | [FFI to C](../chapters/ffi-c.qmd) |
| argument | a value passed when a procedure is called | [Procedures, parameters, and return values](../chapters/procedures.qmd) |
| array | a fixed-size collection of elements of the same type | [`array`, `seq`, and `openArray`](../chapters/collections.qmd) |
| assignment | writing a value into a variable or field | [Variables: `var`, `let`, `const`](../chapters/variables.qmd) |
| backend | a compiler output target (C, C++, JavaScript) | [What Nim is and why](../chapters/what-is-nim.qmd) |
| binary | the compiled file a machine can run | [What Nim is and why](../chapters/what-is-nim.qmd) |
| bitset | a set stored as bits, used for flags | [Enums and sets](../chapters/enums-and-sets.qmd) |
| bitwise | a per-bit operation (`and`, `or`, `xor`, `shl`, `shr`) | [Arithmetic, comparison, and logic operators](../chapters/operators.qmd) |
| block comment | a `#[ ... ]#` comment that can nest | [Comments and doc comments](../chapters/comments.qmd) |
| branching | choosing which path to execute (`if`, `case`, `when`) | [Branching: `if`, `case`, `when`](../chapters/conditionals.qmd) |
| browser | the program that runs the output of a JavaScript build | [Compiling to JavaScript](../chapters/js-backend.qmd) |
| caller | the code that calls a procedure | [Closures and captured variables](../chapters/closures.qmd) |
| calling | the act of running a procedure | [Closures and captured variables](../chapters/closures.qmd) |
| calling convention | the rules for how a procedure is called (`nimcall`, `closure`) | [Closures and captured variables](../chapters/closures.qmd) |
| capture | a closure using a variable from an outer scope | [Closures and captured variables](../chapters/closures.qmd) |
| capture group | the parenthesised part of a pattern captured by `matches` | [Regular expressions with `std/re`](../chapters/regex.qmd) |
| channel | a message queue between threads in Nim | [Threads and channels](../chapters/threads.qmd) |
| closure | a procedure that carries the variables around it | [Closures and captured variables](../chapters/closures.qmd) |
| comment | a note in code that the compiler ignores | [Comments and doc comments](../chapters/comments.qmd) |
| comparison | an operation that compares two values and yields a `bool` | [Arithmetic, comparison, and logic operators](../chapters/operators.qmd) |
| compile time | while compilation runs; before the program starts | [Variables: `var`, `let`, `const`](../chapters/variables.qmd) |
| compiler | a program that translates source code into a binary | [Variables: `var`, `let`, `const`](../chapters/variables.qmd) |
| concept | a requirement on the shape of a type, checked during overloading | [Concepts and type matching](../chapters/concepts.qmd) |
| constant | a value that does not change | [Variables: `var`, `let`, `const`](../chapters/variables.qmd) |
| constructor | the expression that builds an object value (`Person(name: ...)`) | [Objects and constructors](../chapters/objects.qmd) |
| data type | the kind of a value; it decides which operations are valid and how much memory it uses | [Variables: `var`, `let`, `const`](../chapters/variables.qmd) |
| debug build | a build with all checks on, used while developing | [Workflow: `nim r`, `nimble`, editor](../chapters/workflow.qmd) |
| declaration | a statement that introduces a new name | [Variables: `var`, `let`, `const`](../chapters/variables.qmd) |
| default value | the value used when an argument is not given | [Procedures, parameters, and return values](../chapters/procedures.qmd) |
| dereference | reading the value a pointer points to | [`ref`, `ptr`, and `nil`](../chapters/refs-and-pointers.qmd) |
| destructor | a `=destroy` procedure called when a value is dropped | [What Nim is and why](../chapters/what-is-nim.qmd) |
| destructuring | taking a tuple apart into separate variables | [Tuples and destructuring](../chapters/tuples.qmd) |
| directory | a container for files and other directories | [Files, directories, and OS](../chapters/files-and-os.qmd) |
| distinct | a new type with the same representation that does not interchange | [Variant objects and `distinct`](../chapters/variants-and-distinct.qmd) |
| doc comment | a `##` comment that `nim doc` reads | [Comments and doc comments](../chapters/comments.qmd) |
| effect | a procedure trait the compiler can check (`raises`) | [Exceptions and the `raises` effect](../chapters/exceptions.qmd) |
| element | a single value inside a collection | [`array`, `seq`, and `openArray`](../chapters/collections.qmd) |
| endpoint | an address and method served by an API | [An HTTP API with `asynchttpserver`](../chapters/http-api.qmd) |
| entry point | the first file or procedure that runs | [CLI tools with `parseopt`](../chapters/cli-tools.qmd) |
| enum | a type with a fixed list of named values | [Enums and sets](../chapters/enums-and-sets.qmd) |
| environment variable | a configuration value from the parent process | [Files, directories, and OS](../chapters/files-and-os.qmd) |
| error message | compiler output that explains a problem | [Variables: `var`, `let`, `const`](../chapters/variables.qmd) |
| escape sequence | a `\` plus a letter that stands for a special character (`\n`, `\t`) | [Strings, raw strings, and characters](../chapters/strings.qmd) |
| event loop | the scheduler of async tasks in one thread | [`async`/`await` and IO](../chapters/async.qmd) |
| exception | an error condition that can be caught | [Exceptions and the `raises` effect](../chapters/exceptions.qmd) |
| exclusive | the end bound does not count (`0..<5` stops at 4) | [Loops: `for`, `while`, `break`, `continue`](../chapters/loops.qmd) |
| exit code | the number a process returns to its caller | [CLI tools with `parseopt`](../chapters/cli-tools.qmd) |
| export | marking a module symbol that may be used from outside | [Modules, `import`, and `export`](../chapters/modules.qmd) |
| expression | a piece of code that produces a value | [Branching: `if`, `case`, `when`](../chapters/conditionals.qmd) |
| facade | a thin module that unites several other modules | [Modules, `import`, and `export`](../chapters/modules.qmd) |
| file | a unit of storage in the file system | [Files, directories, and OS](../chapters/files-and-os.qmd) |
| flag | a boolean value that marks a state | [CLI tools with `parseopt`](../chapters/cli-tools.qmd) |
| float | a fractional-number type | [Primitive types and literals](../chapters/primitive-types.qmd) |
| foreign function interface | a way to call code from another language, here C | [FFI to C](../chapters/ffi-c.qmd) |
| function | a routine with no side effects (`func`) | [Procedures, parameters, and return values](../chapters/procedures.qmd) |
| garbage collector | the automatic memory manager in the classic GC mode | [What Nim is and why](../chapters/what-is-nim.qmd) |
| generic instantiation | forming a concrete type from a generic at the point of use | [Generics: types and procedures](../chapters/generics.qmd) |
| handler | the function that handles one request or event | [An HTTP API with `asynchttpserver`](../chapters/http-api.qmd) |
| hygienic | a macro or template that does not leak names to the caller | [Templates: code expanded by the compiler](../chapters/templates.qmd) |
| identifier | a name for a variable, type, procedure, or module | [Variables: `var`, `let`, `const`](../chapters/variables.qmd) |
| import | using the contents of another module | [Modules, `import`, and `export`](../chapters/modules.qmd) |
| inclusive | the end bound counts (`0..5` includes 5) | [Loops: `for`, `while`, `break`, `continue`](../chapters/loops.qmd) |
| index | the position of an element in a collection, starting at 0 | [`array`, `seq`, and `openArray`](../chapters/collections.qmd) |
| initialization | filling in the first value | [Variables: `var`, `let`, `const`](../chapters/variables.qmd) |
| input | data that goes into a program | [CLI tools with `parseopt`](../chapters/cli-tools.qmd) |
| integer | a whole-number type | [Primitive types and literals](../chapters/primitive-types.qmd) |
| iterator | an object that yields values one at a time (`yield`) | [Loops: `for`, `while`, `break`, `continue`](../chapters/loops.qmd) |
| line | one line of code or text | [Printing and formatting output](../chapters/printing.qmd) |
| line comment | a `#` comment to the end of the line | [Comments and doc comments](../chapters/comments.qmd) |
| literal | a value written directly in code (`42`, `"text"`, `@[1, 2]`) | [Primitive types and literals](../chapters/primitive-types.qmd) |
| loop | a construct that repeats a block of code | [Loops: `for`, `while`, `break`, `continue`](../chapters/loops.qmd) |
| macro | a compile-time procedure that takes and produces an AST | [Macros: code that builds code](../chapters/macros.qmd) |
| maintainer | the person responsible for looking after a package | [Building and publishing a nimble package](../chapters/nimble-packages.qmd) |
| membership | an `in`/`notin` test on a collection or a range | [Arithmetic, comparison, and logic operators](../chapters/operators.qmd) |
| memory | where a program keeps data while it runs | [Memory management: ARC, ORC, and `=destroy`](../chapters/memory-management.qmd) |
| memory management mode | the compiler's choice of memory manager (`--mm:arc`, `--mm:orc`) | [Memory management: ARC, ORC, and `=destroy`](../chapters/memory-management.qmd) |
| message | text a program sends to the reader or the system | [Workflow: `nim r`, `nimble`, editor](../chapters/workflow.qmd) |
| module | a file or folder that holds code and can be imported | [Modules, `import`, and `export`](../chapters/modules.qmd) |
| multiline string | a `"""..."""` string that keeps line breaks | [Strings, raw strings, and characters](../chapters/strings.qmd) |
| named argument | an argument written together with its parameter name | [Procedures, parameters, and return values](../chapters/procedures.qmd) |
| namespace | a region of names kept apart by module | [Modules, `import`, and `export`](../chapters/modules.qmd) |
| newline | the `\n` character that moves output to the next line | [Printing and formatting output](../chapters/printing.qmd) |
| object | a composite type with named fields | [Objects and constructors](../chapters/objects.qmd) |
| option | a named argument that changes a command's behaviour (`--count=4`) | [CLI tools with `parseopt`](../chapters/cli-tools.qmd) |
| ordinal type | a type whose values can be ordered and counted (`int`, `char`, `enum`) | [Enums and sets](../chapters/enums-and-sets.qmd) |
| ordinal value | the numeric position of an enum value (`ord(green)`) | [Enums and sets](../chapters/enums-and-sets.qmd) |
| output | data a program sends out | [Printing and formatting output](../chapters/printing.qmd) |
| overflow | a value that crosses a type bound and ends in `OverflowDefect` | [Primitive types and literals](../chapters/primitive-types.qmd) |
| overloading | several same-named procedures with different parameter lists | [Procedures, parameters, and return values](../chapters/procedures.qmd) |
| package | a distributable unit of code that can be installed | [Building and publishing a nimble package](../chapters/nimble-packages.qmd) |
| package manager | a tool that installs and manages dependencies (`nimble`) | [Installing Nim](../chapters/installation.qmd) |
| parameter | the name of a value a procedure receives | [Procedures, parameters, and return values](../chapters/procedures.qmd) |
| path | the location of a file in the file system | [Files, directories, and OS](../chapters/files-and-os.qmd) |
| pointer | a value that stores a memory address (`ptr`) | [`ref`, `ptr`, and `nil`](../chapters/refs-and-pointers.qmd) |
| precision | the number of significant digits a float type guarantees | [Primitive types and literals](../chapters/primitive-types.qmd) |
| print | sending text to the output | [Printing and formatting output](../chapters/printing.qmd) |
| procedure | a routine that may have side effects (`proc`) | [Procedures, parameters, and return values](../chapters/procedures.qmd) |
| project scaffold | the file skeleton that `nimble init` creates | [Installing Nim](../chapters/installation.qmd) |
| query | a request for data from a database | [Storing data: `Table`, JSON, and SQLite](../chapters/database.qmd) |
| quote do | a macro block that writes code as usual | [Macros: code that builds code](../chapters/macros.qmd) |
| range | the bounds from start to end (`a..b`, `a..<b`) | [Loops: `for`, `while`, `break`, `continue`](../chapters/loops.qmd) |
| raw string | an `r"..."` string that does not process escapes | [Strings, raw strings, and characters](../chapters/strings.qmd) |
| reference | a value that points to an object on the heap (`ref object`) | [Objects and constructors](../chapters/objects.qmd) |
| reference counting | counting the users of a value to know when to free it | [Memory management: ARC, ORC, and `=destroy`](../chapters/memory-management.qmd) |
| regular expression | a text pattern used by `std/re` | [Regular expressions with `std/re`](../chapters/regex.qmd) |
| release | a version that is published and tagged | [Workflow: `nim r`, `nimble`, editor](../chapters/workflow.qmd) |
| release build | an optimized build, used when shipping the program | [Workflow: `nim r`, `nimble`, editor](../chapters/workflow.qmd) |
| resource | something that must be released after use (a file, a socket) | [Files, directories, and OS](../chapters/files-and-os.qmd) |
| result | a value produced by an operation or procedure | [Procedures, parameters, and return values](../chapters/procedures.qmd) |
| return value | the value a procedure returns | [Procedures, parameters, and return values](../chapters/procedures.qmd) |
| route | the mapping from an HTTP path and method to a handler | [An HTTP API with `asynchttpserver`](../chapters/http-api.qmd) |
| row | one record in a table or query result | [Storing data: `Table`, JSON, and SQLite](../chapters/database.qmd) |
| runtime | while the program is running | [Variables: `var`, `let`, `const`](../chapters/variables.qmd) |
| scope | the region of code where a name can be used | [Comments and doc comments](../chapters/comments.qmd) |
| seed | the starting value of a random generator | [Time and random numbers](../chapters/times-and-random.qmd) |
| seq | a dynamically sized collection of elements of the same type (`seq`) | [`array`, `seq`, and `openArray`](../chapters/collections.qmd) |
| set | a collection of distinct values of an ordinal type (`set[Color]`) | [Enums and sets](../chapters/enums-and-sets.qmd) |
| short-circuit evaluation | `and`/`or` stop as soon as the result is settled | [Arithmetic, comparison, and logic operators](../chapters/operators.qmd) |
| side effect | a change beyond the return value (`echo`, writing a file, mutating a `var`) | [Procedures, parameters, and return values](../chapters/procedures.qmd) |
| slicing | taking a piece of a string or collection by an index range | [Strings, raw strings, and characters](../chapters/strings.qmd) |
| socket | the endpoint of a network connection used by servers and clients | [An HTTP API with `asynchttpserver`](../chapters/http-api.qmd) |
| stack trace | the list of calls shown when the program stops on a defect | [`array`, `seq`, and `openArray`](../chapters/collections.qmd) |
| standard library | the set of modules that ship with the compiler | [Installing Nim](../chapters/installation.qmd) |
| statement | a unit of code that does something, not always producing a value | [Branching: `if`, `case`, `when`](../chapters/conditionals.qmd) |
| string interpolation | inserting values into text | [Variables: `var`, `let`, `const`](../chapters/variables.qmd) |
| subcommand | a second command inside a CLI tool (`tool add`) | [CLI tools with `parseopt`](../chapters/cli-tools.qmd) |
| suite | a group of tests in `unittest` | [`unittest` and test discipline](../chapters/unit-testing.qmd) |
| template expansion | template code copied by the compiler to the call site | [Templates: code expanded by the compiler](../chapters/templates.qmd) |
| test | an automated check of code behaviour | [`unittest` and test discipline](../chapters/unit-testing.qmd) |
| test case | one check inside a suite | [`unittest` and test discipline](../chapters/unit-testing.qmd) |
| thread | a path of execution inside one process | [`async`/`await` and IO](../chapters/async.qmd) |
| timestamp | seconds since 1970 | [Time and random numbers](../chapters/times-and-random.qmd) |
| transaction | a group of changes that must all succeed or none at all | [Storing data: `Table`, JSON, and SQLite](../chapters/database.qmd) |
| tuple | a fixed-order collection of values of different types | [Tuples and destructuring](../chapters/tuples.qmd) |
| type | short for data type; used in prose and code | [Variables: `var`, `let`, `const`](../chapters/variables.qmd) |
| type alias | another name for an existing type, with no new type | [Variant objects and `distinct`](../chapters/variants-and-distinct.qmd) |
| type conversion | changing a value into another type (`int()`, `float()`, `$`) | [Primitive types and literals](../chapters/primitive-types.qmd) |
| typedesc | a type as a value, used for type-based overloading | [Generics: types and procedures](../chapters/generics.qmd) |
| untyped | a macro parameter received before type checking | [Macros: code that builds code](../chapters/macros.qmd) |
| value | the content stored in a variable | [Variables: `var`, `let`, `const`](../chapters/variables.qmd) |
| value copy | copying the contents of a value, not its address | [Objects and constructors](../chapters/objects.qmd) |
| variable | a name for a value | [Variables: `var`, `let`, `const`](../chapters/variables.qmd) |
| variant object | an object whose fields depend on a single tag | [Variant objects and `distinct`](../chapters/variants-and-distinct.qmd) |
| virtual machine | a software layer that runs code on top of the CPU | [What Nim is and why](../chapters/what-is-nim.qmd) |
| warning | a compiler message about code worth checking | [Workflow: `nim r`, `nimble`, editor](../chapters/workflow.qmd) |

New terms go into the master list first, and only then into a chapter.
